label: Contained foundation with fixed law and arbitrarily many explained derivative bearers
definition: Contained.arena k has fixed candidates background, base and derivative n for every natural n; facts law and exists b; two universally accessible worlds with actual world false. Background and law obtain everywhere. Base and every derivative obtain exactly when w=false or k=true. The predecessor of derivative 0 is base, and that of derivative (n+1) is derivative n. The only actual causes and admitted existence-fact reasons follow these predecessor edges. The record for each derivative requires both its predecessor's existence fact and law. fixedResources admits law and background; withBase also admits the base existence fact. baseDependent is base and derivative existence facts. The profile uses exactly the same ontology with #312 circumstance tokens and a primitive source-indexed nature assignment from each derivative to base.
note: Analyst control, attribution deferred. k=false gives contingent base and derivatives with one shared absence world; k=true changes only the modal overlay and keeps the actual reason/record structure. Both worlds retain an existing background bearer, so no empty-world inference is used. All derivative existence is conditional on the same base, and every derivative has an existing distinct cause wherever it exists. No time-indexed events are encoded: n is a dependency layer, and the control claims neither arbitrary births nor a physical dynamics theorem. The stipulated law is necessary and its displayed rules are checked to preserve truth; neither property proves real lawhood or explanation. The failure of derivability from fixedResources concerns the explicit resource policy, while withBase supplies every derivative without explaining base. It does not establish a ban on primitive stops or infer that each derivative is individually brute. There is no new record type or causal relation: the model assigns the existing Arena, Ontic, Profile and Groups fields. See docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md for interpretation boundaries.
